beats.text: Five books worth reading while you're still in your twenties.
One. Meditations — Marcus Aurelius. How to keep your head when everything's uncertain.
Two. Man's Search for Meaning — Frankl. Where purpose comes from when life gets hard.
Three. The Great Gatsby — Fitzgerald. What chasing the wrong dream costs you.
Four. Pride and Prejudice — Austen. First impressions, pride, and learning to really see people.
Five. Siddhartha — Hesse. That wisdom is lived, not borrowed from anyone else.
Read these now and they shape the next decade. Full retellings are on the channel.
